verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers deployments, environments, rollbacks, and CLI usage but never mentions a single configuration file (e.g., vercel.json or an IaC-style manifest) that defines the entire architecture — databases, domains, functions, environments — in one versioned artifact. Environment/variable management (vercel-docs-23) and zero-config framework deploys (vercel-docs-14) are adjacent but do not demonstrate a unified, versionable architecture-as-code file.
